en: A vintage black‑and‑white (with red caption) postcard view over a richly wooded valley toward a historic building complex. In the foreground stands an ornate, castle‑like structure with a tall tower, decorative battlements, arched colonnades, and a domed roof. A long elevated terrace or ramp leads to the building entrance, flanked by lush vegetation. In the distance, more buildings appear among forested hills. The caption at the bottom identifies the scene as a view of the castle in Tharandt, and the printer information and date are also printed.
